text: Stage 1 passed on the disposable packaged demo. A curator signed in through Keycloak, uploaded MRI, fixed the TR mismatch from its finding, accepted the correction, and uploaded and accepted Matching Pennies EEG and a protocol archive. The file inspector showed all three recorded coverage levels, and the check compared 60 fixture files byte for byte. The real PostgreSQL console rehearsal also exercised re-assessment of an earlier interpretation, the ordinary acceptance receipt and resuming the original draft. CI runs both rehearsals.
